Direction 002-2026 on Strengthening Commonwealth Cyber Posture Against AI-Enabled Risks

Direction 002-2026

Publication date: 29 September 2026

PSPF Direction 002-2026 requires Australian Government entities to reduce cyber security risks arising from vulnerable legacy technology systems and to strengthen cyber posture across Australian Government systems.

Direction 001-2026 on Mitigate Vulnerabilities in Cisco SD-WAN Systems

Direction 001-2026

Publication date: 26 February 2026

PSPF Direction 001-2026 requires Australian Government entities to inventory Cisco Software-Defined Wide-Area Networking (SD-WAN) systems, apply updates, assess and report potential compromise and prevent the installation of unpatched versions from all Australian Government systems and devices.
